description:
A JOB OPPORTUNITY AT

GOPA Group Service GmbH

A JOB THAT INSPIRES YOU

We are looking for an M365 Consultant to support the planning, implementation, administration and continuous improvement of Microsoft 365-based solutions across the GOPA Group. In this role, you will help implement and optimize business processes through modern collaboration platforms such as SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft 365, while also developing apps and workflows using Microsoft Power Automate and related Power Platform tools. 
You will work closely with departments, group companies, external IT service providers and technology partners to deliver reliable, user-friendly and future-oriented digital workplace solutions. 

Your responsibilities 


Microsoft 365 and SharePoint administration 

  • Administer and support SharePoint Online, and the wider Microsoft 365 environment, including Teams, OneDrive and related collaboration services.
  • Ensure stable operation, optimization and ongoing support of existing SharePoint and M365 solutions (e.g. intranet, business focused implementation of Microsoft Teams for project use).
  • Support Microsoft 365 evergreen management, including updates, new features and platform changes.

App, workflow and process development 

  • Design, develop and maintain business workflows using Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Support the development of low-code/no-code applications and process solutions using Microsoft 365 and Power Platform tools, such as Power Apps, SharePoint Lists and Dataverse where applicable.
  • Analyze business processes and translate requirements into efficient digital workflows and collaboration solutions.
  • Develop concepts for process mapping, automation and optimization in close cooperation with internal stakeholders.

User support and consulting 

  • Act as a contact person for complex user requests (2nd and 3rd level) related to SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Power Automate and other M365 services.
  • Analyze, prioritize and resolve user questions and problems based on urgency and business impact.
  • Advise departments on the best use of Microsoft 365 tools to improve collaboration and productivity.

Further development and innovation 

  • Monitor technical developments, market trends and Microsoft roadmap updates.
  • Contribute to the further development of the group’s Teams, SharePoint and M365 environment.
  • Evaluate, configure and implement additional collaboration tools and M365-based solutions.

Project work and documentation 

  • Manage or contribute to internal IT projects related to Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform and business applications.
  • Prepare technical concepts, solution documentation and user guides for implemented systems.
  • Support project implementation across GOPA Group locations; occasional travel may be required.

External service provider coordination 

  • Coordinate and collaborate with external IT service providers, software vendors and technology partners in the SharePoint, M365 and Power Platform environment.

Training and knowledge sharing 

  • Prepare and conduct internal trainings, workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions for employees across the group companies.
  • Promote effective and secure use of Microsoft 365 collaboration and automation tools.

ISO / Processes 

  • Follow the regulations and processes defined in the company’s Information Security Management System.
  • Contribute to the further development and improvement of relevant IT and business processes.

A BACKGROUND THAT CONVINCES US

Required qualifications and experience 

  • Professional experience in Microsoft 365 administration, support or consulting, especially SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive and Power Platform
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate for workflow automation
  • Knowledge of M365 governance, permissions, security and compliance topics
  • Good understanding of business processes and the ability to translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Experience in IT project work, documentation and stakeholder communication
  • Strong service orientation and ability to support users with complex requests
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work with different departments and group companies
  • Structured, solution-oriented and independent working style
  • Language skills: English, preferably German and/or Romanian

Desirable skills 

  • Practical experience with SharePoint Lists, Microsoft Forms, Power BI and Dataverse 
  • Experience with change management, user adoption and internal training.
  • Familiarity with working with external IT service providers.
  • Knowledge of quality management processes is an advantage.
  • Experience with SharePoint on-premises and/or migration scenarios is an advantage.

AN ENVIRONMENT THAT MOTIVATES YOU

GOPA R&S offers you a varied position within an international working environment. Our company is part of GOPA Group, GOPA R&S is focused to create added value for the operative companies of the group by improving integration and quality.
 
  • Team & culture: You will join a dynamic, multi-cultural and multilingual team whose members enjoy working together and support each other
  • Meaningful work: Help shape collaboration and automation solutions across the GOPA Group and contribute to digital transformation and process improvement
  • Responsibility: You join a company committed to being environmentally responsible wherever we operate
  • Cross-group collaboration: Work closely with departments, group companies and external partners
  • Development: Benefit from an annual career development and performance review process,clearly defined goals and objectives, a training budget and a mentorship program for new employees
  • Flexibility: We enable flexible work arrangements, including flexible working hours, mobile or telework

READY FOR CHANGE?

We are looking forward to receiving your online application, including your possible start date and salary expectation.

Your contact person: Ana Fruntelata
